methodology.direction: Each relevant logical menu record is classified against nutrition rows.
methodology.relevantMenuRecords: All source-ID-deduplicated ITEM and MODIFIER records, plus ITEM_GROUPING records exposed in a top-level category. Structural MODIFIER_GROUPING records are excluded.
methodology.deduplication: ITEM and MODIFIER occurrences use retailModifiedItemId; category-facing ITEM_GROUPING occurrences use itemGroupId. All source-native name aliases are retained.
methodology.exactMatch: One unique nutrition source row matches any source-native menu alias exactly.
methodology.normalizedMatch: One unique nutrition source row matches after case-folding, HTML sup-tag removal, trademark-symbol removal, apostrophe normalization, punctuation-to-space conversion, and whitespace collapse. No words are removed.
methodology.variantRuleMatch: One unique nutrition source row matches an explicit current-data allowlist for tea word order, standard-portion aliases, sausage patty, or kid's-meal entrée-only labels.
methodology.ambiguous: More than one nutrition source row remains possible after an otherwise valid name match.
methodology.noMatch: No supported unique rule exists; no fuzzy match is attempted.
